[!dolt] skip
# Test bd dep remove unwires dependencies
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'First issue' --description 'Dependency source' --json
extractid FIRST
bd create 'Second issue' --description 'Depends on first' --json
extractid SECOND
bd dep add $SECOND $FIRST
stdout 'Added dependency'

bd dep remove $SECOND $FIRST
stdout 'Removed dependency'

bd show $SECOND
! stdout 'DEPENDS ON'
